notes: Rule 3 sanity check: ikea.com/de/de/ is the genuine IKEA Germany storefront (direct fetch, HTTP 200, no shutdown/closing-down language, EUR pricing, /de/de/ locale, IKEA's own global site chrome/branding, IKEA PS 2026 and other current-season products present). Access route: direct fetch of ikea.com/de/de/ category hub pages (Beleuchtung li001, Lampen & Leuchten li002, Dekoration de001, Spiegel 20489, Rahmen/Bilder/Gemaelde 10757, Vasen & Schalen 10769, Kerzen & Kerzenhalter 10760, Uhren 10759, Geschirr & Kuechenaccessoires kt001 and its sub-hubs) worked with no blocking encountered; category tree built from these pages' own nav links via probe.py nav. Independence/reuse check per the S.N. 100 IKEA UK precedent (pipeline/final_list_batch_sn91-100/c100.json): confirmed the sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com PRIMARY_AREA search API and its numeric category-ID scheme are shared globally across IKEA's country storefronts, not independent per-country IDs -- the same UK category IDs (e.g. 10731 floor lamps, 24858 wall mirrors, 10776 vases, 10785 clocks) resolved to valid DE-market results when queried against https://sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/de/de/search with different (Germany-specific) qty totals and EUR pricing context, confirming this is IKEA's one global product platform with per-country catalogs/pricing/availability rather than a copy or shared catalog with the UK site -- every single qty differs from the UK figures. Every leaf category's own DE-language nav page/slug was independently re-derived from the DE site's own hub pages (not assumed from the UK list) before querying the API, and one DE-only category-tree divergence was found and followed rather than assumed: 10785 is named 'Wand- & Tischuhren' (Wall & Table Clocks) on the DE site versus the UK's pure 'Wall Clocks' -- a product-title sample from the API response confirmed the DE node genuinely includes at least one table clock (IKEA PS 2026 Tischuhr) alongside wall clocks, so it is recorded here as 'Wall & Table Clocks', faithful to the DE site's own broader scope for that ID rather than copied from the UK label. All 58 leaf categories verified empirically per Rule 1 exactly as done for the UK company: (1) fetched the full window (size=999) and confirmed unique product itemNo count equals metadata.max; (2) boundary-tested offset=max-1 (returned exactly 1 item) and offset=max (returned 0 items). All 58 passed both checks cleanly with zero discrepancies, so metadata.max was used directly as qty for every row (see verify_results_de.json in the working directory). Category-ID parity with the UK extraction is 1:1 (58 leaf categories on both sides, same numeric IDs), which is expected under a single global platform and was independently confirmed here rather than assumed. Rule 0 applied: Bathroom Lighting (10736), Outdoor Lighting (17897), Bathroom Mirrors (20490, canonical slug badspiegel-20490 -- found by direct ID probe since it is not linked from the Mirrors hub page's own nav, unlike the UK equivalent) and Vanity Mirrors (20498) were all INCLUDED as room-qualified branches of the type trees (Lighting, Mirrors) they belong to. Rule 0.6 overlap: as on the UK site, Mirrors presents both a shape/type cross-cut (Large/Small/Wall/Round/Standing) and a room/use cross-cut (Vanity/Bathroom/Makeup mirrors, Mirrors with Lights) as separate site-curated category IDs; both trees emitted in full, overlap documented here rather than dropped. Lighting similarly mixes a fixture-type tree (under Lampen & Leuchten li002: Ceiling/Table/Floor/Wall/Desk/Children's/Spotlights/Smart/LED/Rechargeable/Pendant) with a room/use tree (Decorative/Integrated/Smart/Outdoor/Bathroom lighting) at the same level under the Beleuchtung hub; both kept. Excluded per standing rules, all independently confirmed present on the DE nav: LED-Leuchtmittel/dekorative LED-Gluehbirnen (LED light bulbs, parts not fixtures), Schirme & Leuchtenfuesse and Leuchtenschirme (lamp shades/bases, hardware parts), Bluetooth-Lautsprecher (unrelated electronics cross-sell); Raumduefte (home fragrance/diffusers) and Duftkerzen (scented candles, fragrance exclusion -- unscented candles kerzen-unparfuemiert-10782 kept as its own listing exactly as on UK); Pflanzen & Blumen and Kunstpflanzen & -blumen (living and artificial plants/flowers, not decor objects -- only the empty decorative Blumentoepfe & Uebertoepfe pp004 kept, matching UK); Sommerdeko, Herbstdeko, Halloween Party-Zubehoer, Weihnachtliche Dekoration (seasonal/holiday decor); Balkon- und Outdoor Deko (a seasonal-style marketing bundle sitting alongside Sommerdeko/Herbstdeko in the same nav row, not independently verified as its own clean listing distinct from Outdoor Lighting/Flower Pots -- dropped per the mixed-rollup/seasonal exclusion rather than padded in); Geschenkpapier & Geschenktueten, Geschenke zum Schulabschluss/Einzug, Hochzeitsgeschenke (gifts); Pinnwaende (pinboards/noticeboards, office/organisation); Boxen & Koerbe (storage baskets); Badezimmer-Spiegelschraenke (bathroom mirror cabinets, storage furniture with a mirror door -- same exclusion basis as UK's Mirror cabinets); Zimmer- und Indoor-Gewaechshaeuser (greenhouses, gardening); Tischdekoration is not a distinct listing (redirects into existing candle/vase/tray categories, not its own product set); Fussball Deko (licensed sports theme decor); all Vorratsbehaelter/Frischhalteboxen, Kochgeschirr, Kuechenutensilien, Besteck, Vorlegebesteck, Backutensilien, Messer & Schneidebretter, Spuelutensilien & Abtropfgestelle, Kuechentextilien, Tischwaesche & Sets, Servietten (paper napkins, textile), Kinderbesteck/-geschirr/-becher, Picknick-Zubehoer, Babygeschirr & Laetzchen, Isoliergefaesse (vacuum flasks), Kaffeezubereiter & -zubehoer, Getraenkezubehoer (bar tools: corkscrews/ice-cube accessories) -- all functional/appliance/textile, out of scope, mirroring the UK exclusion list exactly. All *-Serie pages (NYMAENE, RANARP, ARSTID, HEKTAR, KORKEN, IKEA 365+, etc.) are collection/marketing pages, not categories, skipped per the standing 'Collections' exclusion. Serviettenstaender (Napkin Holders, 20562) was pulled out of the mixed Servietten & -halter parent as its own clean leaf category exactly as on the UK site; the textile/paper-napkin sibling was dropped, not padded in.
